description.para: The ALERT outputs of the INA745A power monitors are open-drain and are wired-OR onto the power-good inputs below. A line therefore reads low either because the supply is not good or because an INA745A on that net has asserted ALERT. See PWR_MON_TABLE (power.h) for the rail-to-net mapping and pwr_checkAlerts() for how the two causes are distinguished.
